name: bhasini
description: Transliteration, script conversion and translation for the 22 scheduled languages of India.

interface.longDescription:
Bhasini Indic Scripts writes and translates text in the 22 scheduled languages of India: Assamese, Bengali, Bodo, Dogri, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Kashmiri, Konkani, Maithili, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Nepali, Odia, Punjabi, Sanskrit, Santali, Sindhi, Tamil, Telugu and Urdu.

Spelling uses a rule-based transliteration engine, so the same input always gives the same spelling. It covers less widely supported scripts too, such as Ol Chiki (Santali), Meetei Mayek (Manipuri) and Perso-Arabic Kashmiri and Sindhi.

What you can ask:
- Write words in a native script: "Write vaNakkam and nanRi in Tamil script" gives வணக்கம், நன்றி.
- Convert text between Indian scripts: Hindi नमस्ते भारत becomes Kannada ನಮಸ್ತೇ ಭಾರತ, so a reader of one script can read text written in another.
- Translate between English and any of the 22 languages, or between two of them: "Where is the railway station?" becomes Tamil ரயில் நிலையம் எங்கே?
- Learn to type: find the keys for any letter on a phonetic keyboard, such as zh for ழ in Tamil.
- Write numbers in native numerals: 2026 becomes २०२६ in Hindi or ২০২৬ in Bengali.
- Look up the supported languages, scripts and language codes.

Transliteration writes the sounds of words in another script; translation carries their meaning into another language. Translation runs AI4Bharat IndicTrans2 and Google Gemma on Cloudflare Workers AI, for up to 2,000 characters a request and 10,000 characters a day.

No account or sign-in is needed. Bhasini receives only the text passed to its tools, never your conversation. That text is processed in memory and is not stored or logged. See the privacy policy for details.

Made by Codegres. The engine is open source under the MIT license at github.com/Codegres-com/Bhasini.
capabilities: Transliterate romanised words into 22 Indian language scripts
Convert text between Indian scripts, e.g. Devanagari to Kannada
Translate text between English and 22 Indian languages, or between two of them
Show the phonetic keyboard keys for any letter
defaultPrompt: Write vaNakkam and nanRi in Tamil script
Translate 'Where is the railway station?' into Tamil
Write the Santali word johar in Ol Chiki

positive.description: Romanised Tamil words written in Tamil script
positive.prompt: Write the Tamil words vaNakkam and nanRi in Tamil script.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls transliterate with language ta and replies with வணக்கம் and நன்றி.

positive.description: Hindi text rewritten in Kannada script
positive.prompt: Rewrite नमस्ते भारत in Kannada script so a Kannada reader can read it aloud.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls convert_script with targetLanguage kn and replies with ನಮಸ್ತೇ ಭಾರತ, noting the words are still Hindi.

positive.description: Keyboard keys for a Tamil letter
positive.prompt: Which keys do I press to type ழ on a Tamil phonetic keyboard?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_keymap with language ta and answers that zh (or Lx) types ழ.

positive.description: A year written in native numerals
positive.prompt: Write the year 2026 in Devanagari numerals and in Bengali numerals.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls native_digits for hi and bn and replies with २०२६ and ২০২৬.

positive.prompt: Translate 'Where is the railway station?' into Tamil.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls translate with targetLanguage ta and replies with ரயில் நிலையம் எங்கே?

negative.description: Translation between two languages that are not Indian. Bhasini only translates to and from the 22 scheduled languages of India, so no Bhasini tool should be called; ChatGPT translates itself.
negative.prompt: Translate 'Bonjour, comment ça va ?' into English.

negative.description: Unrelated coding request. No Bhasini tool should be called.
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that reverses a string.

negative.description: Unrelated question that mentions an Indian city. Bhasini has no weather or web data, so no tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Chennai today?

publication.release_notes: New translate tool: translate text between English and the 22 scheduled languages of India, or between two of them (AI4Bharat IndicTrans2 and Google Gemma on Cloudflare Workers AI). Up to 2,000 characters a request and 10,000 a day.
